description: Golden evaluation set for the GroundedDocs English sample corpus. Categories: easy (single-section factual), multi-hop (requires combining multiple sections), unanswerable (not in the corpus; must refuse), ambiguous (conditional/partial information requiring caveats). Gold is expressed as document_id + section leaf, resolved to chunk ids at eval time.

questions.question: How many days of annual leave do employees accrue per year?
questions.reference_answer: 25 working days per year.

questions.question: How long is the probation period for new hires?
questions.reference_answer: 90 days.

questions.question: How many days per week can an employee work remotely after probation?
questions.reference_answer: Up to three days per week.

questions.question: What is the maximum value of a gift an employee may accept without declaring it?
questions.reference_answer: Below 50 USD; above this must be declined or declared.

questions.question: In which month are salaries reviewed?
questions.reference_answer: January.

questions.question: How much notice is required when an individual contributor resigns?
questions.reference_answer: 30 days.

questions.question: How much notice is required when a manager resigns?
questions.reference_answer: 60 days.

questions.question: Who owns a security incident end to end?
questions.reference_answer: The Incident Commander.

questions.question: What severity classification applies to a data breach or production outage?
questions.reference_answer: SEV-1.

questions.question: What must happen before any remediation action is taken during an incident?
questions.reference_answer: Evidence must be preserved in the forensic evidence vault.

questions.question: Within how many days of incident closure is a Lessons Learned review held?
questions.reference_answer: Within 30 days.

questions.question: Is multi-factor authentication required for accounts with access to production data?
questions.reference_answer: Yes, MFA is mandatory for all such accounts.

questions.question: How long is customer personal information retained after the service contract ends?
questions.reference_answer: Duration of the contract plus 12 months.

questions.question: Which data class includes customer personal information and source code?
questions.reference_answer: Confidential.

questions.question: How quickly must a suspected breach of the security policy be reported?
questions.reference_answer: Within one hour.

questions.question: What is required to access the corporate network remotely?
questions.reference_answer: A managed device, the approved VPN, and MFA.

questions.question: On what basis is access to AcmeCorp systems granted?
questions.reference_answer: Least privilege, with a named owner and approver.

questions.question: When during probation is employee performance reviewed?
questions.reference_answer: At the 60-day mark.

questions.question: What is the maximum number of unused leave days that carry over?
questions.reference_answer: Up to 10 days.

questions.question: What must an employee do with a gift from a supplier under active negotiation?
questions.reference_answer: Decline or declare it to compliance.

questions.question: Can an employee who is still in probation work remotely, and how many days?
questions.reference_answer: No — remote work is only available after completing the probation period.

questions.question: A manager resigns while holding confidential data. What notice do they give and what happens to the data?
questions.reference_answer: 60 days notice; confidential data must be handled per retention/deletion rules.

questions.question: Within what time is a terminated employee's access revoked, and what may follow a violation?
questions.reference_answer: Access revoked within 24 hours; violations may lead to disciplinary action up to termination.

questions.question: During a SEV-1 incident, how often must status be updated and who owns the incident?
questions.reference_answer: Status every 30 minutes; owned by the Incident Commander.

questions.question: What must the Communications Lead do before any external message is sent during an incident?
questions.reference_answer: External notifications must be reviewed by Legal first.

questions.question: A remote worker's laptop containing customer data is stolen. Which policy actions apply?
questions.reference_answer: Customer data is Confidential and must be processed in encrypted storage; the suspected breach must be reported within one hour.

questions.question: An employee works remotely on a personal device. Is that compliant with policy?
questions.reference_answer: No — remote access requires a managed device plus VPN and MFA.

questions.question: A new hire on day 20 requests annual leave. Is that permitted, and how many days do they have?
questions.reference_answer: Leave requests are separate from probation; they accrue 25 days per year.

questions.question: Who should be contacted when a suspected policy violation occurs?
questions.reference_answer: Security on-call, plus compliance or legal as relevant.

questions.question: A manager accepts a $200 gift from a vendor and then suspects a breach. Which policies apply?
questions.reference_answer: Gifts above $50 must be declined or declared; a suspected breach must be reported within one hour.

questions.question: A departing contractor has production access. What must happen to their access and within what time?
questions.reference_answer: Access revoked within 24 hours of separation.

questions.question: An employee working from home cannot complete MFA. Can they still access production data?
questions.reference_answer: No — MFA is mandatory for production access.
